类 ValidationUtils

java.lang.Object
ValidationUtils
public class ValidationUtils extends Object
Stateless utility methods for common input validation and type conversion.

All methods are static and the class is not intended to be instantiated. Conversions return a caller-supplied fallback on failure rather than throwing exceptions, keeping UI code concise.
